schema.description: Idle-gap / utilization read model for either one TaskType (fleet-wide) or one associate, over a trailing window. taskType and associateId are mutually exclusive -- whichever endpoint served the request populates its own identifying field and omits the other.

associates.description: The distinct associate count contributing to this result. Always 1 for a per-associate result; for a task-type result, the distinct-associate count over the window (0 for a never-observed task type).

taskSeconds.description: Summed measured task duration over the window.

idleSeconds.description: Summed recorded (closed) idle-gap seconds over the window -- never includes openGapSeconds.

openGapSeconds.description: The still-running idle time for a subject idle right now: now minus their last known activity, clamped to the window. Computed at READ time, never persisted (see the idleness ADR's "Trailing idleness" limitation). Zero when the subject is not currently idle, and always zero on the task-type endpoint: an open gap belongs to one associate, so it is only reported by the per-associate endpoint.

utilizationPct.description: 100 * taskSeconds / (taskSeconds + idleSeconds + openGapSeconds). Null when nothing was observed in the window -- never a fabricated number.

schema.title: Utilization
